title: People’s Mañanera November 11
author: Pedro Gellert
content:
_Every day, President Claudia Sheinbaum gives a morning presidential press
conference and Mexico Solidarity Media posts English language summaries,
translated by Mexico Solidarity 's Pedro Gellert. Previous press conference
summaries are available [here](https://mexicosolidarity.com/mananera/)._

**IMSS-Bienestar Brings Free Surgeries and Laboratory Services to Communities  
** The program has already provided 58.3 million consultations across 24
states and built 21 new health-care facilities. The 120-day plan calls for
more than 16,000 surgeries in 296 rural hospitals and the opening of 7
teaching hospitals. “We do things out of love,” President Claudia Sheinbaum
declared.

**Aguascalientes Raises Its Housing Goal from 6,000 to 20,000  
** Sheinbaum described it as “the most important housing program in Mexico’s
history.” More than 8,000 housing units have already been allocated in the
state, and the program is expected to close the year with 17,000—nearly 86% of
the goal for the current presidential administration.

**Sheinbaum Calls for Clarification on the 2006 Fraud Following Fox’s
Admission  
** According to WikiLeaks, in 2006, Arturo Sánchez, then an advisor to the
Federal Electoral Institute (IFE), visited the U.S. Embassy weeks before the
election and said that National Action Party (PAN) candidate Felipe Calderón
would win by three percentage points. Sánchez was asked to explain why he made
that visit and on what basis he made his prediction.

**From Fobaproa to a Budget for Well-being and 13.5 Million People Lifted Out
of Poverty  
** Sheinbaum recalled the Bank Savings Protection Fund (Fobaproa), the attempt
to lift Andrés Manuel López Obrador’s parliamentary immunity, and Calderón’s
war on drugs to explain the 2018 shift toward greater well-being. This
priority continues in the 2027 Budget with more funding for health, education,
rural areas, public security, and science.

**Lie Detector  
** It is not true that 65% of schools in Mexico lack internet access and
computers

It is not true that the amendments to the Copyright Law establish fines for
the publication of memes or satire

It is not true that the Digital Economy Law for Digital and Electronic
Payments will eliminate cash and that the government will control where and
how payments are made

It is not true that subsidies to the Federal Electricity Commission (CFE)
doubled under the Fourth Transformation
